# R5.15 — Planned-slot population and historical analysis coordinates (leg a of the `4d13371f` SPLIT — sole contract owner)

**Summary.** Lands the whole eval-side planned-slot population /
method-metadata contract — `hharness_eval::population` — the dossier
S.1 shared contract every method ticket (R5.16, R5.36–41, receipt and
study reports) consumes. Ticket `docs/tickets/184_R5.15__population.md`
(seq 184, rescoped by its 2026-11-02 dated note). Scoped review verdict
**SPLIT** on the ≤1000 trigger with a **corrected seam** (record
`planning/2026-11-02_R5.15b-split-review.md`, ruling `4d13371f`):
bounds/metadata are contract, not consumer; the hh-analysis
`planned_population` adapter is seq 184a
(`184a_R5.15b__population-adapter.md`) and lands there.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-eval/src/population.rs` (new, ~880 lines) — records-in
  module:
  - Records — `Availability` (separate axis; `grade_pending` is an
    admission state, never a seventh class), `SlotSubject`,
    `PlannedSlot`, `PopulationInput` — slots keyed `(task, split,
    stratum, arm, replicate, plan, attempt, subject)`.
  - `assemble` — reconciles once: required universe (absent member →
    `IncompleteUniverse`; short cells keep planned/not-run rows — M
    counts slots, never attempts); first subject primary + first
    admissible completed retry recovery (`recovered`, never best-of);
    all attempts retained on attempt-level axes; pinned-watermark read
    (`seq > pin` → `HistoryLeak`, resolved-without-pin →
    `WatermarkMissing`); pins republish as `watermarks`.
  - Three named populations — `raw`, `canonical`,
    `joint_task_pass_without_observed_veto` — beside the six outcome
    classes, observed-veto axis and availability axis; `unknown` never
    clean; vetoed passes leave `canonical` and report beside.
  - `contrast_bounds` — per-(task,arm) `[⌊s/M⌋, ⌈(s+u)/M⌉]` cells and
    the equal-task contrast `[Σw(L_test−U_control), Σw(U_test−L_control)]`,
    `w_t = 1/T`, outward ppm rounding; unrun tasks retain weight
    (full-width `[0,1]` cell); explicit `test_minus_control` direction
    (the protocol's B−A); legacy `compare` a−b untouched.
  - `BoundsDecl` — admits `Unit` (or a `Bounded` that is `[0,1]`) only:
    `Unbounded`/`RightCensored`/non-unit `Bounded` → typed refusals;
    no invented finite bound.
  - `MethodMetadata` — the S.1 spine verbatim (`descriptive` interval
    kind — never confidence/credible/concentration).
  - `PopulationError` — the closed 13-variant refusal set.
- `crates/hh-eval/tests/r5_15.rs` (new, 10 checks) — contract battery.
- `crates/hh-eval/src/lib.rs` — `pub mod population`.
- Zero new event classes (CC10), zero dependencies, no schema/wire
  change; pure records-in, no durable writes.
- **Removed from this diff (seq 184a scope):** `hh-analysis`
  `population.rs` adapter, `error.rs` `Population` variant/`From`,
  `lib.rs` export, and its `tests/r5_15.rs` battery — re-landed by the
  next worker under `184a_R5.15b__population-adapter.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1 (positive D/E) — MET at contract scope:** one input/metadata
  contract reconciles planned slots, first subjects, all attempts and
  historical (pinned) selection; three named populations distinct from
  the six classes/veto/availability; D1 golden bounds `[−400000,
  500000]` ppm at M=50 (`d1_golden_bounds_and_explicit_b_minus_a`);
  whole unrun tasks retain weight; explicit B−A target with legacy
  a−b preserved.
- **AC-2 (negative D/E) — MET at contract scope:** duplicate/missing/
  conflicting keys, `IncompleteUniverse`, short cells and
  pending-grade availability cannot yield a full estimate (u +
  pending_slots, `full=false`); unknown is not clean; unbounded/
  right-censored/non-unit metrics refuse (`UnboundedMetric`,
  `CensoredMetric`, `UnsupportedBounds`) — no invented finite bound;
  `HistoryLeak`/`WatermarkMissing` refuse latest-history leakage.
- **AC-3 (ownership/evidence) — contract-scope stamps only:**
  REQ-D-001/002/003/104 and REQ-A-004/102 stamped
  contributing/scoped-slice at the contract layer; **no REQ
  discharged** — R/P legs remain owed to R5.49 (D-*) and R5.43 (A-*);
  consumer-scope stamps owed to seq 184a.
- **AC-4 (scoped verification) — MET:** fails-without compile-red at
  base `3f9ca250` (`E0432 unresolved import
  hharness_eval::population` + follow-ons); `cargo fmt --all --check`
  clean; `cargo test -p hharness-eval` all 14 targets ok incl. r5_15
  10/10; consumer sweep — `hharness-analysis` builds + tests green
  without the adapter; scratch stores only.
- **AC-5 (universal gate) — MET:** guard PASS `DISPATCH — R5.15`
  pre+post; REQ ids stamped here; DF-R5.1-1 carried; ADR-0394 authored
  (landing decisions incl. corrected seam + sole-contract-owner
  posture), ADR index + REVISIT_TRIGGERS regenerated in sync, ADR-0394
  homed on BL-47 sources; run/PR/INDEX/LEDGER agree.
